headline: Widget Class Dependencies and Impact
what_breaks: src/textual/app.py — relies on Widget for application structure
src/textual/dom.py — depends on Widget for DOM node representation
src/textual/events.py — uses Widget for event handling
why: The Widget class serves as the foundational element for all widgets in the application, impacting multiple components. Changes here can disrupt the layout, event handling, and overall application behavior.
checklist: Review changes to Widget class methods and properties
Check interactions with src/textual/dom.py and src/textual/app.py
Ensure compatibility with event handling in src/textual/events.py
